newsitem.title: INDIA: India's IRFC gets $52 mln credit from Canada's EDC.
newsitem.headline: India's IRFC gets $52 mln credit from Canada's EDC.

text.p: Canada's Export Development Corp (EDC) will provide a $52 million line of credit to the state-run Indian Railway Finance Corp (IRFC) to partially fund a $85 million purchase of locomotives and technology by the Indian Railways, Bank of America said on Monday.
The bank, which acted as an advisor to the deal, said in a statement that an agreement between the two parties was signed on March 27 in Ottawa.
"This is the first time that EDC has taken direct corporate risk on a public sector borrower in India without a soverign guarantee from the Government of India," the statement said.
"EDC has also agreed to provide financing for the non-Canadian content in the purchase. The equipment is being sourced from GM Locomotives, USA," it added.
"The total value of imports of equipment and technology is expected to be $85 million, of which $52 million is being financed under this agreement by EDC," the statement said.
